project.name: Save the Children
project.logline: In a world where humanity survives only as consciousness inside a machine, a young person fights to escape an oppressive system — unaware that the rebellion itself, the system, and every feeling of purpose they have ever known are the inherited memories of the last scientists who built the world that imprisoned them.
project.setting: The Institute — a decaying research facility, 400 years apart
project.spine: A young person fights to escape an oppressive system — unaware that the rebellion itself is inherited from the last scientists who built it
project.controlling_idea: Freedom requires the courage to leave what you know
